questions.explanation: Standard output is typically line-buffered when connected to a terminal, but block-buffered or fully buffered when redirected. Flushing ensures the prompt appears immediately.
bufio.Scanner allows reading entire lines including spaces easily via Text() or Bytes(), whereas fmt.Scan splits inputs by whitespace.
Receiving EOF from standard input indicates the input stream has closed, so the REPL should exit cleanly rather than looping infinitely.
